item.title: Self-Hosted Linux Init Systems: OpenRC vs s6 vs runit for Server Management (2026)
item.description: The init system is the first process started by the Linux kernel (PID 1) and is responsible for booting the system, starting services, and handling shutdown. While systemd dominates the Linux server landscape, many administrators prefer alternative init systems for their simplicity, transparency, and smaller attack surface.
